question_text: Define gestation period. What is the duration of gestation period in the human beings?

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: Definition
steps.why: The period is measured between two events, so the definition has to name both ends of it.
common_mistakes: Defining it as the time from birth. It ends at birth.
Leaving out where the embryo develops.
lines: The gestation period is the time for which
an embryo develops inside the uterus.
It runs from fertilisation to delivery.

steps.label: Its duration
steps.why: A doctor counts from the last period because that date is known, while the date of fertilisation usually is not.
common_mistakes: Giving nine months without a number of weeks.
Quoting 40 weeks from fertilisation. That count starts at the last period.
steps.memory_tip: 38 weeks from fertilisation, 40 from the last period.
steps.margin_note: Give both counts and say what each is measured from.
lines: Human gestation is about 38 weeks from

lines.text: It is 40 weeks from the last menstrual cycle

insider_note: Two figures are correct and they differ: 38 weeks from fertilisation, 40 from the last period. Say which is which.
